title: FM-Mamba: An Efficient Native 2D Selective State Space Model with Stability-Aware Discretization
abstract: arXiv:2611.22061v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When applied to two-dimensional features such as images, Mamba-based methods either flatten the feature map into 1D sequences and fuse multiple scans, which breaks spatial adjacency and multiplies computation, or recurse directly on the 2D grid but rescale the recurrence with a fixed input-independent factor and aggregate only the predecessors on a single anti-diagonal, leaving the discrete step unconstrained by 2D stability theory. We propose \textbf{FM-Mamba}, a native 2D selective state space model built on the general Fornasini--Marchesini (FM) model. Its coupled recurrence evolves along both spatial axes; cross-axis coupling induces a discrete diagonal-predecessor term $\tilde A_0$, and two independent input-dependent step sizes $\Delta_1(i,j)$, $\Delta_2(i,j)$ govern propagation along the two axes, so that the coefficients adapt per position and per direction. translated_title: FM-Mamba：一种具有稳定性感知离散化的高效原生二维选择性状态空间模型
translated_abstract: 当应用于图像等二维特征时，基于Mamba的方法要么将特征图展平为一维序列并融合多次扫描，这会破坏空间邻接关系并成倍增加计算量；要么直接在二维网格上进行递归，但使用一个固定的、与输入无关的因子对递归进行缩放，且仅聚合单一反对角线上的前驱状态，使得离散步长不受二维稳定性理论的约束。我们提出了FM-Mamba，一种建立在一般Fornasini–Marchesini（FM）模型之上的原生二维选择性状态空间模型。其耦合递归沿两个空间轴同时演化；跨轴耦合产生了一个离散对角前驱项 $\tilde A_0$，两个独立的、依赖于输入的步长 $\Delta_1(i,j)$ 和 $\Delta_2(i,j)$ 分别控制沿两个轴的传播，使系数能够随位置和方向自适应调整。归一化比率 $r_k=a_{0,k}/(a_{1,k}a_{2,k})$ 可推导出一个闭式……（摘要原文不完整）
tldr: 提出FM-Mamba，一种基于Fornasini-Marchesini模型的原生二维选择性状态空间模型，通过沿双轴演化的耦合递归、输入依赖的双步长和稳定性感知离散化，解决了现有Mamba方法处理二维特征时破坏空间邻接、计算量倍增及缺乏二维稳定性约束的问题。
en_tdlr: FM-Mamba is a native 2D selective state space model built on the Fornasini-Marchesini framework, featuring coupled bi-axial recurrence with input-dependent dual step sizes and stability-aware discretization to overcome the spatial adjacency loss, computational overhead, and lack of 2D stability constraints in existing Mamba-based methods.
